building_name: Clayton W. Dement Fire Station (Purdue University Fire Department)

sources.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
sources.use: Identity; three-bay station description; brick material; historical context; 10,637 gross-square-foot figure. The page does not provide a measured elevation or detailed floor plan.
Confirms Purdue University Fire Department location at 1250 W. Third Street and service role.

sources.feature_id: FID 211; BLDG_ABBR DMNT; BUILDING_N Clayton W. Dement Fire Station; building number 1048
sources.measurement_method: Source polygon vertex coordinates converted to the project's approximate campus XY meters using the transform below. No footprint fitting or rescaling was applied after conversion.
sources.transform: x=(longitude+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); y=(latitude-40.4274)*111040.0; z=up. This is a local approximation, not a surveyed CRS.
sources.uncertainty: GIS extrusion field is recorded as 15 but its unit/definition is not explicit in the snapshot. Two levels are recorded; actual overall roof height remains unmeasured.

sources.view: yaw 0 degrees, pitch 0 degrees, 900x600 thumbnail; captured directly from the Street View panorama on 2026-10-26
sources.use: Current front elevation appearance: low brick office wing, two visible light-colored sectional apparatus doors, red canopy/fascia, entrance, attached taller charcoal ribbed hall. Current capture date was not available; 2026 in the image copyright is not treated as imagery capture date.
sources.uncertainty: Only two vehicle doors are visibly clear in this view, while the Purdue historic record describes a three-bay station; a third recessed bay is modelled as an interpretation and should be independently reviewed.

sources.use: Purdue attributes the fire-truck image to the Clayton West Dement Station; the image supports apparatus-bay scale and an internal steel roof-truss structure, but it is not an exterior elevation photo.

geometry_edits: Replaced the single untextured massing block with a GIS-footprint brick shell, textured walls, roof/fascia, a high attached apparatus hall, sectional bay doors, service entry, glazing, and red canopy. Elevated hall geometry was clipped to the northern portion of the source polygon rather than added as a separate guessed rectangular footprint.
Added UV-based brick pattern and subtle surface relief; added dark ribbed-metal upper cladding and roof, pale sectional-door panels, dark glazing, and concrete thresholds.
Preserved campus-world XY placement and the existing asset ID, path, collection name, and scene name.
model_revision.height_status: The 14.6 m model roof is an estimate interpreted from imagery and GIS levels/extrusion. No surveyed elevation source was found.
model_revision.orientation_status: The footprint follows Purdue GIS directly. The main apparatus frontage was placed on the south/recessed frontage based on the current Street View orientation; the third bay and interior layout remain uncertain.
model_revision.interior_status: Interior rooms and fire apparatus are not modeled. Purdue's available truck photo is interior imagery but does not provide a floor plan; adding room layouts would be speculative.
